payload.description:
Implements LIM-2a1ca5. Write acceptance scenarios first, then make the loader satisfy them.

Scope:
- Accept portable YAML and JSON profiles with relative reference samples.
- Validate required fields, check names, rules, density thresholds, and forbidden detector-score keys with actionable errors.
- Keep the existing profile shape backward compatible.

Definition of done:
- Behave covers valid YAML, valid JSON, malformed config, and a forbidden detector-score key.
- No Papyrus imports or paths.
- Existing editorial scenarios remain green.

Out of scope: new finding types or CLI apply behavior.
payload.title: Luna: contract-test portable style configuration
